notes.title: Second anniversary!
notes.content:
Lovely people,

On the occasion of the second anniversary of [b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b], the new patch includes:
[list]
[*]Fixed some bugs regarding some images after loading.
[*]Better pace in some parts of the game.
[*]Added chapter titles for both main parts of the game: [b]Random Access Memories[/b] and [b]Incidents in an expanding universe[/b]. (Pop culture references in your face!).
[/list]

If you have played it, recommend it, if you haven´t... Grab that huge sale!
Lex loves you all!

notes.title: February HotFix
notes.content:
Greetings, Majesties,

This minor patch fixes a (weird) problem when picking up the book you need in order to write the FLTR walkthrough (first stage). As I said this bug is a strange one, so please let me know if you still have the same problem. In that case I will implement another solution.

Thank you so much. Keep playing and don´t forget to leave a review, you beauties.

notes.title: Minor patch (as promised)
notes.content:
Majesties, this minor patch contains:[list]
[*]Typos correction.
[*]Fixed an issue with an achievement.
[*]The pace of some cutscenes has been improved so they don´t feel too rushed.
[*]Other minor issues.[/list]
Thank you! If you like the game consider leaving a review or Steam will bury it deep down the Steamverse...

tags.feature: [*]The pace of some cutscenes has been improved so they don´t feel too rushed.

notes.title: Your daily minor patch
notes.content:
Majesties, strange things happenned (not to all but just one case is enough to check everything), so:

[list]
[*]Fixed a missed interaction in the stage with your multiple versions (diamond - painting to get a key object).
[*]One dialogue option appeared when it shouldn´t. Fixed, however if this happens again you will still be able to choose it but won´t work if you´re not carrying the item, which is quite obvious (when you see it you´ll understand it).
[*]Another one I can´t remember (going through all the programming melted my brain).
[/list] 

If this weird problems persist (so far everybody has been able to beat the stages and progress) I´ll add some creative solutions (puzzles, gameplay or story won´t be altered).

Thank you so much for your comprehension. Be kind: review.
